name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and keeps the interface sleek, matching competitors like Manus and Graphify. The trade-off is that some users may prefer a light theme for readability in bright environments, but we can measure adoption and adjust later. This keeps the interface consistent with industry standards while giving users control.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes don’t just strain eyes—they bury errors in shadows and mute critical signals. A one-click toggle to light mode still hides the real trade-off: users won’t notice mislabeled data or misaligned graphs until it’s too late. Instead, default to a high-contrast light theme with a *subtle* dark mode option—visibility first, then preference. Settle it with A/B tests measuring error detection rates, not just glare complaints.
